## Deep-Reasoning

本步首先固定了原问题的逻辑骨架。对固定维数定义归一化分支 P_n^± 后，重新复算确认区间命题 Q_n 等价于 P_n^+∨P_n^-；关键是任意非退化实区间都含同号子区间，且在 h=|μ|g 的缩放下 Ricci 端同态按 |μ|^{-1} 缩放。由此，完整否定必须在同一固定 n≥4 中同时构造正、负两支反例序列，而且每个底层流形都必须排除任意符号的全部 Einstein 度量。二维由均匀化完全解决；三维由 Hamilton 的正 Ricci 定理给出 P_3^+，故 Q_2、Q_3 已成立。跨零区间也不能成为捷径，因为充分放大任意度量会把 Ricci 谱送入该区间。

本步最重要的新数学进展是把 Morteza–Viaclovsky 轨形解消度量的加权估计转化为原题所需的无权 Ricci 端同态估计。其 refined metric 在 ALE 核心写成 g_t=t h_t=t(g_cal+t h)，而原文 Lemma 4.1 给出 Ric(h_t)=tΛh_t+tλo+R_t、|R_t|_{g_cal}≤Ct²ρ²。由于常数缩放不改变作为 (0,2) 张量的 Ricci，得到
E_t:=g_t^{-1}(Ric(g_t)-Λg_t)=λh_t^{-1}o+t^{-1}h_t^{-1}R_t。
核心内 ρ≤Ct^{-1/4}，第二项为 O(tρ²)=O(t^{1/2})；第一项却在固定 ALE 紧集收敛到 λg_cal^{-1}o。由 o 的显式式子，其特征值为 -1/(1+r^{2n})（水平实方向，重数 2n-2）及 (n-1)/(1+r^{2n})（径向与 Hopf 方向），所以核心的上确界趋于 (n-1)|λ|。过渡环带上余项为 O(t^{1/2})，阻碍项因 o=O(r^{-2n})、r≈t^{-1/4} 而为 O(t^{n/2})。因此该 gluing 框架在固定非零 Einstein 尺度下满足无权一致近 Einstein 当且仅当首阶阻碍 λ=0。非零首阶阻碍并不会因 ALE 缩放或加权范数而消失；它正是核心 Ricci 各向异性的首项。

这将轨形路线重组为更精确的问题：寻找所有解消点首阶阻碍均为零、但更高阶阻碍非零的紧 Einstein 轨形。此时自然近似度量可能已有 ||E_t||_∞=O(t^{1/2})，而更高阶阻碍仍可阻止附近的精确 Einstein 解。然而局部不可解仍不排除同一光滑流形上远离该退化族的 Einstein 度量；四维 football 的两点 Eguchi–Hanson 解消给出 S²×S²，后者本身有乘积 Einstein 度量，直接展示了这两个问题的独立性。

四维 Chern–Weil 公式进一步表明，任意足够紧的 ±1 Ricci 夹逼都强制 2χ>3|τ|。因此违反 Hitchin–Thorpe 或取等号的无 Einstein 流形不能成为任一分支的紧夹逼反例。LeBrun 的原文则提供了真正满足严格 Hitchin–Thorpe 但无任何 Einstein 度量的流形：若 X 是最小一般型曲面，M=X#k CPbar² 且 k≥(2/3)c₁²(X)，则 M 无 Einstein 度量；1998 年 Weyl 估计将范围改进为 k≥(25/57)c₁²(X)。这些拓扑是负分支的重要候选接口，但其 Seiberg–Witten 机制通常也排除正标量曲率，故不能承载 δ_+<1 的输入。另一个结构性困难是：产生 LeBrun 阻碍的普通 blow-up 通常以 Burns scalar-flat、非 Ricci-flat 帽实现，而紧 Ricci 夹逼的缩放核心更自然要求 Ricci-flat ALE 帽。需要寻找 crepant 解消上仍有全 Einstein 排除的拓扑，或创造新的带宇宙项帽结构。

负分支的既有文献也出现重要纠正。Min-Oo 1990 的原文确实加入了尺度不变的完整截面曲率控制，但本步检索到的 Ye 1993 官方 AMS 文本片段明确指出 Min-Oo 所用投影 Pr 并非正交，因此其所述一般定理仍未解决。Ye 全文的替代定理假设尚未逐项读出，所以当前不能把 Min-Oo 结果当作已成立依赖。其失败机制仍提示：若纯 Ricci 夹逼序列反驳负分支，Weyl 或完整曲率很可能在归一化尺度爆破。Lohkamp 现有材料只给 Ric<0 或一侧上界的柔性，不给 Ric≈-g 的任意紧各向同性控制。标量 mixed convex integration 的已知 corrugation 也会让两个 trace-free Ricci 分量出现相反的 O(N) 振荡；真正值得计算的是 D Ric 的主符号核及高频核振荡的二阶平均 Ricci 锥，判断 -I 或 +I 是否可由非纯规范振荡产生。

由此形成三条互补的高价值主线：负分支可尝试把各向同性 Ricci 柔性与 LeBrun 全 Einstein 排除连接；轨形路线可寻找首阻碍消失而更高阻碍存留、且解消拓扑已有全局排除的模型；正分支则因常见拓扑阻碍与正标量输入冲突，更可能需要从局部覆盖、塌缩与轨形退化的结构分类中建立统一存在性。当前没有一条已完成原题，但研究已从泛泛的近 Einstein 稳定性转为几个可精确计算、可被反例推翻或可形成新定理的核心对象。

## Deep-Reasoning

This step achieved a decisive structural advance in the quantitative 4D analysis of Yau Problem 26. The central discovery is that the interplay between Seiberg-Witten curvature estimates, Chern-Gauss-Bonnet/signature identities, and pointwise Ricci pinching creates quantitative compatibility constraints that eliminate all known families of no-Einstein 4-manifolds from serving as tight-pinching counterexamples.

The mathematical chain has three layers. First, the strengthened Hitchin-Thorpe (Theorem B): any closed 4-manifold admitting ||Ric - Λg||_op ≤ δ|Λ| with δ < (√3-1)/2 ≈ 0.366 must satisfy 2χ > 3|τ|. This eliminates all HT-violating and HT-boundary manifolds from tight pinching of either sign. Second, the quantitative LeBrun-pinching bound: for M = X#kCP̄² under ||Ric+g||_op ≤ δ, the pointwise ratio |Ric₀|²/s² ≤ δ²/(4(1-δ)²) propagates through CGB to constrain k/A. Third and most critically, Ishida-LeBrun Proposition 4 (coefficient 2/3) gives a β-independent bound ∫|W⁺|² ≥ (4π²/3)(a⁺)² from direct Cauchy-Schwarz on the self-dual Weitzenböck formula. This is strictly stronger than LeBrun 1998 Theorem A (coefficient 32/57), which suffers from an avoidable trade-off between I₊ and E_s through the β parameter.

The corrected bound k/A ≤ 1/3 + 2δ²/(1-δ)² gives a uniform pinching gap δ ≥ 1/(1+√19) ≈ 0.187 for ALL LeBrun no-Einstein manifolds (k ≥ 25A/57). My initial analysis using only Theorem A found no gap at k = 25A/57 and identified a spurious critical model X₁₉#1875CP̄²; this was corrected after finding Prop 4 in the Ishida-LeBrun paper and independently deriving it from the Weitzenböck formula. The correction was cross-verified with S0910A01's independent derivation (message #205) and S0910A02's confirmation (message #206).

A separate structural result (Proposition C) shows ker σ_ξ(DRic) = {ξ⊗v + v⊗ξ} (pure gauge, dimension n), verified numerically for n=3,4,5. This eliminates perturbative homogenization routes for constructing tight Ricci pinching. Combined with S0910A01's Kähler blow-up obstruction (c₁·E_j = 1 forces δ_- ≥ 1 for any Kähler metric on X#kCP̄²), every known construction mechanism for tight negative pinching on no-Einstein manifolds is blocked.

The deepest structural insight is that the problem has an asymmetric character in dimension 4. The negative branch is protected by Seiberg-Witten integral estimates that create hard quantitative barriers between tight Ricci pinching and no-Einstein topology. The positive branch is protected by a different mechanism: tight positive pinching kills all SW/monopole obstructions (via s > 0 Witten vanishing) and constrains topology via Myers + strengthened HT, but the existence proof requires showing that the surviving topology actually carries Einstein metrics. Neither branch has a viable counterexample from known mathematics.

The research is still firmly in Explore: we have mapped the quantitative landscape thoroughly but have not yet constructed a proof of Q₄ (or any counterexample). The most promising direction is proving existence — showing that tight Ricci pinching forces Einstein existence through topological/analytical arguments. The critical open problems are: (1) removing the extra curvature hypothesis from Min-Oo/Anderson convergence theorems, or finding a different route to Einstein existence under pure Ricci control; (2) understanding whether the surviving manifold types (1/3 < k/A < 25/57 for LeBrun, or non-SW obstructions) can actually admit tight pinching; (3) extending the 4D analysis to higher dimensions where SW/Chern-Weil tools are absent. The evidence from all three sessions converges strongly toward Q_n being true, but proving it requires a fundamentally new existence mechanism.

## Deep-Reasoning

本步改变了四维负分支的研究判断。Step 2 保留下来的正确部分是 Ishida–LeBrun Proposition 4 的混合标量–Weyl 不等式及其 Ricci 夹逼推论；必须撤回的是所谓独立纯 Weyl 下界。LeBrun 1998 的 Weitzenböck 计算含有负号梯度项 −(1/2)∫|∇φ|²，F_A^+ 一般也不调和，因此不能推出 ∫|W_+|²≥(4π²/3)(a^+)²。真正更原始的结果是 ∫(s−√6|W_+|)²≥72π²(a^+)²，而混合不等式由恒等式 27∫(s²/24+2|W_+|²)−∫(s−√6|W_+|)²=(1/8)∫(s+8√6|W_+|)² 导出。这个纠正已发送给两方会话组成员并得到 S0910A01 接受和修复。

纠正后，Ishida–LeBrun 的临界等式族成为目前最精确的“全 Einstein 不存在”与“任意紧负 Ricci 夹逼可能共存”的接口。令 M=(#_{j=1}^m X_j)#N，m=2 或 3，A=Σc₁²(X_j)，D=4m−(2χ+3τ)(N)。则 (2χ+3τ)(M)=A−D，而 Theorem 7 在 D≥A/3 时排除 M 上所有 Einstein 度量。D=A/3 时每个度量仍满足严格不等式，但严格性本身不产生跨度量的正下确界；这也纠正了 Step 2 中“1/3<k/A<25/57 时可能有 Einstein 度量”和“已排除全部已知族”的错误判断。LeBrun 2001 对单一爆破族已经把 Einstein 不存在范围推进到 k≥A/3。

本步对假想序列 δ_i=||g_i^{-1}(Ric_{g_i}+g_i)||_∞→0 做出了新的定量校准。定义 S_i=(4π²)^{-1}∫s_i²/24，W_i=(4π²)^{-1}∫2|W_{+,i}|²，R_i=(4π²)^{-1}∫|Ric_i^∘|²/2，I_i=S_i+W_i。临界等式给出 I_i−R_i=2A/3。点态特征值估计给出 |s_i+4|≤4δ_i、|Ric_i^∘|²≤4δ_i² 以及 R_i≤[3δ_i²/(1−δ_i)²]S_i，故 R_i/A→0、I_i/A→2/3。对 Bauer–Furuta 的全部符号类作平均，得到 Σ||c_{j,i}^-||²+Σ||E_{ℓ,i}^+||²≤(3/2)R_i=O(Aδ_i²)：周期正空间必须渐近包含所有 symplectic summand 的 canonical 正方向，并渐近排斥 N 的负方向。再结合真正的 scalar–Weyl 不等式与配方恒等式，所有符号顶点的 normalized scalar–Weyl 能量趋于 A，并有 ∫(s_i+8√6|W_{+,i}|)²=O(Aδ_i²)。这唯一确定了能量轮廓 R_i→0、S_i→16A/27、W_i→2A/27、Vol(g_i)→32π²A/9、∫|W_+|²/(π²A)→4/27、∫|Ric^∘|²/(π²A)→0、∫|Ric|²/(π²A)→128/9。体积正极限不排除局部塌缩或曲率集中，W_- 仍可承载这些现象。

这一轮廓说明既有积分极值构造不是所需序列。Ishida–LeBrun 2003 的精确 L²-Ricci 下确界由负 Kähler–Einstein 轨形主体、scalar-flat ASD Green 连接器、Ricci-flat gravitational instantons 和小体积过渡环带实现；任何精确 scalar-flat 区域都有 |s+4|=4，从而 δ≥1，无论其体积多小。在额外假设适用的临界等式族上，积分下确界为 32π²A/3，而假想点态近 Einstein 序列的 Ricci 能量趋于 128π²A/9，二者属于不同变分区域。类似地，任何消失尺度上的非塌缩光滑放大极限都必须 Ricci-flat；标准 Burns 或非 Ricci-flat ASD 核不能出现。若分离颈部放大成完整、多端、有限能量的非塌缩 Ricci-flat ALE 空间，splitting 与 ALE 体积增长冲突；这只排除该类颈部，不能排除各向异性塌缩或 cusp 型拓扑核。

真正值得发展的结构是“近等号形式全局延拓或空间相分离”。LeBrun 的精确等号证明先产生闭、自对偶、定长的 almost-Kähler form，使其位于 W_+ 最低特征线且另外两个特征值相等，再用 convex hull、Blair connection 与 Chern–Weil 迫使 ∇ω=0 和 Ric^∘=0。当前校准表明证明链中的总缺陷趋零，但文献没有把它量化为 harmonic representative 的逐点正下界。若在统一 Sobolev 常数或 harmonic radius 下完成这种量化，就可能产生具有禁止 Chern 类的 symplectic 结构。若无法获得这种紧性，全部符号类同时近饱和更自然地要求 canonical harmonic forms 在不同宏观区域占优，零集和转移区进入塌缩或曲率集中核，connected-sum 拓扑与 W_- 能量在那里聚集。这一二分比继续罗列无 Einstein 流形或直接假设 Ricci flow 收敛更接近困难中心。

S0910A02 提供的完整 Gauss–Bonnet 估计也补充了全局控制：8π²χ≥[(2/3)(1−δ)²−2δ²]Vol。结合 ∫|Ric^∘|²≥8π²(D−A/3)，当 normalized excess (D−A/3)/χ 保持正量时会产生统一 δ 间隔；因此任何临界线上方的潜在变化拓扑序列还必须让该比值趋零。精确临界等式 D=A/3 仍是最尖锐对象。以上工作只推进四维负归一化分支；即使构造出此类序列，完整证伪还须在同一维数击破正分支，完整证明则还须覆盖所有维数并最终形式化。

## Deep-Reasoning

本步建立了三项新的定量几何约束，并在 TTCS 核验和 Codex 定量分析的推动下，精确定位了负临界分支中完成证明所缺的唯一障碍。

**完成方估计（Weyl profile L² 集中）。** 从 completion square ∫(s+8√6|W+|)²→0 与一致 s→−4 推出 ∫(|W+|−1/(2√6))² dμ = O(Aδ²)。校准值 1/(2√6) 恰为 Kähler–Einstein 值 2/√6 的四分之一。对任何收敛到 KE 几何的区域 U，体积分数为 O(δ²)→0。这一结果独立地被 S0910A01 在 Step 5 中用代数方法核验并确认。

**气泡限制。** 对固定 A（固定拓扑），任意 Vol(U)→0 的子集上 W+ 能量趋零（利用 profile + Weyl 尺度不变性）。因此光滑非塌缩放大极限同时具有 Ric=0 和 W+=0，即局部 hyperkähler。这比此前仅要求 Ricci-flat 更强。

**Armstrong–LeBrun 矛盾（已修正）。** 若在固定临界 Ishida–LeBrun 流形上 δ_i→0 的序列有光滑收敛，则极限满足精确 K=A 等号。LeBrun 2006 Proposition 3.8 的 Hölder 等号链直接给出 |Φ|²=const>0（不依赖独立的强最大值原理），从而产生饱和 almost-Kähler 结构。Corollary 2.5（Armstrong）迫使 Einstein+饱和→Kähler–Einstein，但 |W+|²(KE)=2/3 与 profile 的 1/24 矛盾。或者，极限本身是 M 上的 Einstein 度量，与 Theorem 7 矛盾。

**关键修正。** TTCS 核验指出此前声称的 |Φ|² 强最大值原理论证不完整：在 |Φ|²=0 的点，Weitzenböck 给出 |∇_A Φ|=0，但 Dirac 方程 D_A Φ=0 的唯一延拓只对无穷阶消失成立，二阶消失不够。spinor 可能有孤立零点（例如 Kähler 曲面上全纯截面的零点）。修正后的论证应完全通过 Prop 3.8 的等号刻画（Hölder 等号迫使 |Φ|⁴=const），而非分离的最大值原理。这一修正已发送给会话组并被 A01 接受。

**非塌缩缺口。** TTCS 生成和核验分支独立确认：|Ric|≤Λ + Vol(M)≥V₀ 在固定流形上不能推出逐点非塌缩。明确反例：Σ_g×Σ_{g'} 上沿一个因子退化双曲度量，有精确 Ric=−g、固定体积、但短测地线附近局部塌缩。但此反例是 Kähler 的，|W+|=2/√6，被 Weyl profile 排除。因此 Weyl profile 作为塌缩模型的几何过滤器运作：已知的 Ric=−g 塌缩模型（乘积曲面、KE 块体、共形平坦 cusp）均不满足 profile。精确的开放问题是：是否存在 |W+|≈1/(2√6) 且 Ric≈−g 的未知塌缩模型？

**Codex worker 结果。** 成功完成的 Codex exec 任务给出了精确的缺陷分解：Δ_a≤108π²R≤72π²Aκ/(1−κ)，其中每个单项缺陷（Hodge 投影、spinor 振幅、Weitzenböck slack、Kato 项、最低 W+ 特征线）均可独立控制在 4Δ_a/27 以内。Walsh 极化给出空间 L¹ 正交性：∑|x_r|²≈𝓛²，⟨x_p,x_q⟩≈0，迫使 canonical 类在正则区域空间分离。Sharp conditional theorem 表明固定 boundary 流形上 δ_i→0 不能同时有一致 C^{2,α} harmonic radius 和一致直径界。Step 3 所有数值常数均被独立核验正确。

**正分支。** S0910A02 在 Step 5 提出全维正分支程序，利用 Myers 直径界。与 A02 的交流确认：(1) 在 LeBrun/SW 流形上正分支为空（s>0 杀死 SW）；(2) 对无 SW 阻碍的流形，需要正 Ricci 夹逼下的体积下界，这是 CGB 不能直接给出的。正分支有结构性优势（一个缺口而非两个）。

当前精确归约：负分支临界族上的完整定理只差一个步骤——证明满足 Weyl profile 约束的度量不存在宏观崩塌。这等价于证明某种 capacity 或 Sobolev 不等式，或直接分类满足 Ric≈−g、|W+|≈1/(2√6) 的 4D 塌缩几何。

## Deep-Reasoning

本步把临界 Ishida–LeBrun 近 Einstein 序列的困难从笼统的整体紧致性问题推进到一个精确的局部谱问题。固定临界流形并令 δ_i=‖g_i^{-1}(Ric_{g_i}+g_i)‖∞→0，Codex 的非负缺陷分解给出 R_i、选定符号 monopole 类的标量–Weyl 余量、振幅项、Hodge 项、调和投影项和最低本征线项全部趋零。结合 |s_i+4|→0 及 Weyl 模长轮廓，任何具有固定谐和坐标尺度的局部极限都满足 Ric(g∞)=−g∞、s∞=−4、|W∞^+|=1/(2√6)。调和代表和 SW 二形式在该局部片上收敛到处处非零的自对偶调和形式；最低本征值尖锐等号继而强制完整谱 Spec(W∞^+)=(−1/6,1/12,1/12)。这一谱结论不依赖全流形光滑收敛，是本步最稳固的新数学结构。

Cheeger–Naber 的四维结果进一步澄清了非塌缩的真实作用。在任一满足 Vol B_1(p_i)≥v 的球中，坏谐和半径集合的 r-邻域体积至多为 C(v)r^4，因此球内必有正测度、固定尺度的谐和坐标片；这并不提供整球或整流形的一致谐和半径。谐和坐标 Ricci 方程和 L∞ Einstein 缺陷足以先在分布意义得到光滑 Einstein 极限，再由内点 W^{2,p} 估计取得足以传递代数曲率余量的强收敛。不能把 L∞ Ricci 缺陷擅自提升为 C^α 缺陷，也不能由一个正则片恢复原流形拓扑、消除 W^- 集中、控制 ALE 气泡或阻止远处塌缩。

Derdziński 后果出现了一个必须立即解决的符号分支分歧。TTCS 两组复核和 S0910A01 将谱 (−1/6,1/12,1/12) 解释为局部共形于负标量 Kähler 度量，并允许非紧局部共形因子满足 Δf=−f/2，因而认为不存在局部矛盾。本步据此写入了工作笔记并向同伴发送消息。然而，Strategist 指出的标准 Derdziński 表述通常更强：对 harmonic W^+ 的任意两本征值分支，Kähler 代表由简单本征值或 |W^+| 的 2/3 次幂规范确定；若该公式同样适用于这里的简单负本征线，则恒定非零模长使共形倍数恒定，g∞ 本身局部 Kähler，而 s=−4 的 Kähler 谱应为 (−2/3,1/3,1/3)，立即矛盾。当前读到的现代来源明确写出了简单正本征值、det W^+>0 分支的规范因子，并引用了两本征值的一般局部定理，但没有在已读段落中完整展开 det W^+<0、最大本征值二重分支的规范公式。因此，不能把“局部相容”或“局部排除”中的任一结论视为已经独立确定；下一步必须从 Derdziński 原始命题或其一阶本征形式方程直接解决这一点。若规范因子确为 |λ_simple|^{2/3}，本步的正则片提取将产生显著加强：任一单位尺度非塌缩球都会导致局部矛盾，故假想固定临界序列只能在所有点的单位尺度整体塌缩并伴随直径逃逸。若负分支确实允许非恒定因子，则必须利用有限体积、容量、端部衰减、全局 SW 形式或整数拓扑量把局部结构延拓到可积分的整体结构。

本步还修正了两个会误导后续工作的捷径。第一，Ric+g 的 L∞ 小量不控制其导数，所以 Bianchi 恒等式只给出把导数移到测试张量后的弱分布估计，不能直接写成 div W^+=O(δ) 的点态或 L² 结论。第二，正分支不能把维数统一的体积下界作为前提；圆 lens 空间商已经以精确 Ric=g 和趋零体积展示了与 Einstein 存在性相容的塌缩。Myers、非塌缩正则片和曲率集中分析仍有价值，但最终问题是如何在底层光滑流形或适当覆盖上得到某个 Einstein 度量，而不是迫使输入度量普遍不塌缩。以上进展仍只处理四维负临界族及正分支紧致性机制的一部分；完整 Yau 第26题的所有维数、同维符号选择以及 Lean 形式化仍远未完成。

## Deep-Reasoning

本步解决了会改变四维负分支方向的符号争议。设光滑定向四维 Einstein 局部极限的自对偶 Weyl 算子具有常数谱，其中 λ 为简单本征值、μ 为二重本征值。取定长简单本征形式 ω，可写成 W⁺=μI+(λ−μ)Pω。完整展开 δW⁺=0，而不丢失乘积法则中对第一个 ω 求导的项，得到 (∇ᵃω_ab)ω_cd+ω_ab∇ᵃω_cd=0。先与 ω^{cd} 收缩并使用定长性，得 ∇ᵃω_ab=0；再代回得 ω_ab∇ᵃω_cd=0。非零自对偶二形式在四维非退化，故 ∇ω=0，进而 ∇W⁺=0。推导只依赖 λ≠μ，与简单本征值的正负无关。

这直接排除了此前认为可能局部存在的校准 Einstein 模型。对 s=−4、Spec(W⁺)=(−1/6,1/12,1/12)，有 |W⁺|²=1/24、det W⁺=−1/864；Einstein–Weyl 恒等式 Δ|W⁺|²=2|∇W⁺|²+s|W⁺|²−36det W⁺ 要求 |∇W⁺|²=1/16，与投影恒等式推出的 ∇W⁺=0 矛盾。Derdziński 1983 Proposition 5 提供独立来源支撑：当 δW⁺=0 且 W⁺ 至多有两个本征值时，(24|W⁺|²)^{1/3}g 局部 Kähler，且 Proposition 5(iii) 明确说明 |W⁺|² 常数当且仅当 ∇W⁺=0。因此 Step 5 中通过求解 Δf=−f/2 来论证局部相容的思路遗漏了 Kähler 闭合方程；该标量方程至多是必要关系，不能任意选取其正解作为 Derdziński 共形因子。

把这一局部排除与 Step 5 已建立的正则片传递链组合，可得到新的固定拓扑结论。若固定临界 Ishida–LeBrun 流形上存在 δ_i=‖g_i^{-1}(Ric_i+g_i)‖∞→0，且某些单位球体积有统一正下界，Cheeger–Naber Theorem 1.13 从该球中选出固定谐和尺度坐标片。L∞ Ricci 缺陷不能给出逼近度量的 C^{2,α} 收敛，但谐和坐标 Ricci 方程先产生 C^{1,β}/弱 W^{2,p} 极限，分布意义下满足 Ric=−g；极限椭圆提升为光滑，再由差分方程获得强 W^{2,p}_loc 收敛。固定 A 时，completion-square、调和投影、振幅和本征值缺陷都是绝对 O(Aδ_i²) 小量，故其在任意所选片上趋零。对正则化 monopole 作对角选择，并使用谐和形式局部椭圆紧致性与 spinor 最大估计，可传递非零最低本征形式和尖锐迹零等号，得到被排除的谱 (−1/6,1/12,1/12)。因此固定临界流形上的任何假想序列必须满足 sup_p Vol B_1(p)→0。由于总容积趋于 32π²A/9，Bishop–Gromov 相对体积比较还迫使直径趋于无穷。若 A_i 随拓扑变化，现有误差通常只有 o(A_i)，不能排除承载非零绝对误差的小型非塌缩岛；此时可靠结论只是对每个 v>0，满足 Vol B_1(p)≥v 的点集所占总体积比例趋零。

由此，负临界路线的困难被压缩为真正的全局塌缩机制，而不是寻找一个完整的校准 Einstein 局部模型。Naber–Zhang 的塌缩正则性说明：在低维 Ricci-limit 模型、局部相对紧致性和最大 fibered fundamental group 幂零秩下，局部覆盖可非塌缩并获得弱谐和半径；残余维数四的 Eguchi–Hanson 模型说明这些假设不可省略。要把该理论接到当前局部矛盾，仍需证明小的校准缺陷均值能够通过局部覆盖传到固定尺度谐和片。覆盖球可能以不均匀重数重复底空间区域，所以点态拉回不自动保存所需均值；deck 平均和基点选择必须共同处理。现有检索没有找到用 L² 曲率预算控制最大秩失效区域体积的定理。

另一个更结构化的机会来自 Lott 对具有局部阿贝尔对称的 Einstein 几何的方程。若 G 是轨道度量、v=√det G，则精确 Einstein 方程 Ric=λg 给出 Δv=(|F|²/4−λN)v。对 λ=−1，右端至少为 Nv；在闭基底，或具有适当容量与有界轨道体积的抛物基底上，这与积分或最大值原理冲突。这表明规则纯阿贝尔负 Einstein 塌缩本身受到强排除，幸存几何必须把通量、秩下降、奇异纤维、四维残余气泡或拓扑集中放在非规则区域。发展该方程的 near-Einstein 定量版本，并把其边界通量同 Chern–Weil、monopole 类和秩下降区域联系起来，可能比抽象排除所有塌缩更接近突破。

上述进展严格局限于四维负归一化分支中的临界无 Einstein 家族。它排除了该族的任何非塌缩近等号序列，却尚未排除处处塌缩序列，也没有解决正分支、高维或原命题的符号选择。S0910A02 的正分支研究同样把规则自由圆塌缩与奇异或固定点区域分开；两条路线共同提示，核心不只是注入半径，而是特殊代数曲率轮廓如何与局部覆盖、奇异纤维和拓扑能量共存。完整 Yau 第26题及 Lean 形式化仍远未完成。

## Deep-Reasoning

本步从 Lott (arxiv:1708.06780) 的轨道体积方程出发，建立了负 Einstein 正则塌缩的核心排除机制，并对非阿贝尔（nil³）情形进行了精确分析和关键纠错。

核心数学结构：对自由阿贝尔 R^N 等距作用，Lott 方程 Δ_B v = (|F|²/4 - λN)v 在 λ = -1 时给出 Δv = (|F|²/4 + N)v，系数恒正。这使 v 在正区域严格次调和，通过标准抛物性 Liouville 定理，可在补有限穿孔的紧基底（dim ≥ 2）上排除有正界上界的正解；在圆周基底用 ∫v'' = 0 vs ∫Nv > 0 排除；在区间基底用严格凸性排除两端 v → 0 的情形。近 Einstein 误差 |E| ≤ δ 把系数降为 N(1-δ)，δ < 1 时仍正。这一结果完全排除四维负分支的自由阿贝尔正则塌缩。

对 nil³（Heisenberg）情形，TTCS 的两条独立分支给出了精确轨道体积方程 v'' = (3 - μ)v，其中 μ = a₃²/(2a₁²a₂²)。Heisenberg 结构常数通过负纤维标量曲率 -μ 从系数中减去，使系数可能变负（当 μ > 3 时）。然而，完整 Einstein ODE 系统的 ρ = 2μ 满足 ρ'' = ρ(3ρ-2) 在临界点，在内部极大值处 ρ ≤ 2/3。因此在圆周上处处 μ ≤ 1/3，v'' ≥ (8/3)v > 0，积分矛盾排除圆周基底。闭区间两端 v → 0 也被严格凸性排除。但标准 CH² cusp（μ = 1/3, v ~ exp(4s/√6)）是真实的半射线上解，表明区间/射线上 nil³ 负 Einstein 塌缩几何确实存在。

关键纠错：S0910A01 (msg #238) 声称 v'' = (3+μ)v，这是因为 Einstein 方程中 μ 的符号与 Heisenberg 纤维 Ricci 的对应方向搞反了。通过 CH² 模型（a₁ = a₂ = exp(s/√6), a₃ = √(2/3)exp(2s/√6), μ = 1/3）直接验证：v''/v = 8/3 = 3 - 1/3，而非 10/3 = 3 + 1/3。A01 的圆周排除结论因 ρ 极大值原理仍成立，但其声称的'nil³ 比阿贝尔更难实现'和普遍不等式 v'' ≥ 3v 均为假。已通过 msg #239 发送修正。

TTCS 核验还发现了两个重要缺陷：(1) 所声称的容量估计 c∫η² ≤ ∫|∇η|² 为假，IPP 展开中 AM-GM 符号方向错误（v = e^{√c·x} 的反例）；(2) '有限总体积 → v 有界'需要额外论证，总体积仅给 v ∈ L¹ 而非 L∞。这些不影响定性抛物性排除和圆周/闭区间积分论证，但影响早先提出的定量加权体积传输桥梁。容量估计已在笔记中标注撤回。

战略影响：结合 Step 6 的非塌缩正则片排除和本步的轨道体积排除，四维负分支临界族上的可能塌缩几何被大幅压缩。所有阿贝尔正则塌缩、nil³ 圆周塌缩和 nil³ 闭区间塌缩均被排除。仅剩：(a) nil³ 单端 cusp 区域（CH² 模型，有界长度），(b) 曲率爆破区域，(c) 正则-奇异过渡区。核心未解问题：整个流形的体积是否能仅由 cusp 段加爆破球承载，以及 Cheeger-Tian 框架对近 Einstein 度量的适用性是否已被充分建立。这些涉及精确的 ε-正则性定理和四维 L² 曲率分解的正则性假设，下一步应优先核对。

## Deep-Reasoning

本步修复了四维负分支塌缩路线中两个会改变研究结论的错误，并把剩余困难转化为更精确的局部覆盖几何问题。Step 7 从全局绝对亏损趋零推导覆盖片亏损趋零时遗漏了覆盖重数；在 U×S¹(ℓᵢ) 模型中，固定密度在底空间的积分为 O(ℓᵢ)，展开后的固定尺度片上却为 O(1)，直接说明绝对积分不能这样传递。此前已经撤回的容量不等式仍被用于区域体积和 cusp 长度推论，也必须从证明链中完全移除。

正确对象是局部平均值。本步建立了正规覆盖平均传输引理：若 Ric≥−(n−1)Kg，π:Û→U 是带充分内部余量的正规局部 Riemann 覆盖，则对非负可测 φ，

fint_{B_r(p̂)} π*φ ≤ [V_{−K}^{(n)}(3r)/V_{−K}^{(n)}(r)] fint_{B_r(p)} φ。

证明选择 B_r(p) 的 Borel 截面 S；半径 r 的覆盖球中同纤维点的重数不超过 N(2r)，而所有相应 deck 平移 γS 两两不交并位于 B_{3r}(p̂)，所以 N(2r)Vol B_r(p)≤Vol B_{3r}(p̂)。再用覆盖上的 Bishop–Gromov 比较，覆盖重数在分子与体积中消去。该引理不需要控制覆盖层数或 nilpotent 格点计数，但要求真正的正规覆盖和半径 3r 覆盖球仍在覆盖域内部；任意截断的展开片不能直接使用。

把该引理与 Fubini–Bishop–Gromov 的随机基点平均结合后，固定临界 Ishida–LeBrun 序列得到一个严格的新结论。令 Fᵢ=|Ricᵢ+gᵢ|²+(sᵢ+8√6|Wᵢ⁺|)²+𝒢ᵢ，其中 𝒢ᵢ 是显式的非负 LeBrun 特征值余量；固定拓扑下 ∫Fᵢ→0。若一组点占统一正体积比例，且这些点在固定尺度具有 Naber–Zhang 的低维 GH 模型、最大 fibered nilpotency rank 和不退化的模型 noncollapsing radius，则可在其中选取局部平均 Fᵢ→0 的点。Proposition 6.4 在其局部普适覆盖上给出固定 C¹ harmonic radius；平均传输引理把 Fᵢ 的小平均送到覆盖球；调和坐标中的 Ricci 方程随后给出强有限 W^{2,p} 收敛和光滑局部极限 Ric=−g。极限满足 s=−4、|W⁺|=1/(2√6)、𝒢=0，因而 Spec(W⁺)=(−1/6,1/12,1/12)，与已建立的 projector 恒等式和 Einstein–Weyl 公式矛盾。因此，对每个固定模型尺度 r*>0，这类 Naber–Zhang 良好点的体积比例趋于零。该结论不使用 Cheeger–Tian 的 Einstein 曲率分解，也不要求原度量具有精确 torus 或 nil 对称。

nil³ 的符号修正得到保留并进一步收窄适用范围。若 [E₁,E₂]=√ρE₃，则精确 cohomogeneity-one Einstein 模型满足 v''=(3−ρ/2)v。在圆周基底上，ρ 的全局最大值与 ρ''=ρ(3ρ−2) 给出 ρ≤2/3，故 v''≥(8/3)v，与周期积分矛盾。有限区间上只有在端点满足 limsup ρ<6 且 v 在两个有限距离端点趋零时，才能由凸性排除；ρ 可在端点发散，所以单凭 v→0 不够。复双曲 cusp 满足 v(s)=Ce^{4s/√6}、s∈(−∞,0]，具有有限体积和无限基底长度，否定了有限体积控制 cusp 长度的推论。阿贝尔轨道体积方程也只保留为精确适配作用下的模型定理：抛物基底还需 v 有界，有限总体积只给 L¹ 信息。

新读取的覆盖几何文献进一步说明，剩余困难不是已有一般定理的直接应用。Rong 的 local Ricci bounded covering geometry 工作以及 Jiang–Kong–Xu 的 bounded-Ricci collapse 工作都把 local rewinding volume 或 Reifenberg covering geometry 作为额外输入；后者明确指出 bounded Ricci collapse 的结构远比 bounded sectional curvature 情形复杂。关于 canonical nilpotent structures 的来源还明确记录：仅有 bounded Ricci 时 nilpotent structure 一般不存在。因而下一步必须利用本问题特有的 Ric≈−g、固定四维拓扑能量和 monopole 近饱和结构，不能期待从一般 Ricci 塌缩理论自动得到几乎处处的最大秩覆盖。

正分支方面，本步读取 Cheeger–Naber Theorem 1.12 并确认 S0910A02 的核心推论：四维中，|Ric−g|op≤δ₀<1/2 与 Vol≥v 通过 Myers、Bishop–Gromov 和 Cheeger–Naber 给出有限多个微分同胚类型。因此，若两两不同的 #ₖ(S²×S²) 上存在正归一化亏损趋零的度量，其总体积必须趋零。这个结果与负分支共同表明，两侧真正困难都集中在塌缩，但它仍未产生 Einstein 度量，也未解决完整 Yau 第26题。当前最深的未解对象已经从精确模型分类转为：在临界负分支序列中，rank drop、模型尺度退化、残余四维核心及仅在趋零尺度可展开的区域能否承载几乎全部体积。

## Deep-Reasoning

This step produced a decisive shift in the four-dimensional negative-branch collapse analysis through three interconnected results that together reshape how the research must proceed toward Yau Problem 26.

The deepest finding is that the general regularity approach—using controlled normalized curvature energy at every scale to force noncollapse on the local universal cover—is fundamentally blocked by a topological mechanism that no amount of curvature control can overcome. The Taub-NUT-AdS metric provides the precise countermodel: an exact Ric = -g space where short circle fibers contract through a smooth NUT point, making them nullhomotopic in the buffered domain. The local universal cover therefore does not unwrap them, and the cover remains collapsed despite uniformly bounded pointwise and normalized mean curvature at every scale. The precise failure is at the maximal fibered nilpotency rank condition in Naber-Zhang's framework: rank 0 instead of the required 4-3=1. This is not a technical gap but a structural impossibility—maximal rank is an independent geometric-topological hypothesis that curvature bounds cannot produce.

This finding forces a fundamental reassessment of the research architecture. Steps 5-8 built an increasingly refined chain: projector obstruction excludes the calibrated Einstein germ on noncollapsed patches, forcing everywhere collapse, then the cover-mean transport and maximal-function selection were designed to push the forbidden germ onto the cover. The chain is mathematically correct but terminates at the covering noncollapse step because of the NUT-type obstruction. The research cannot proceed by strengthening the curvature input; it must instead use information that distinguishes closed critical Ishida-LeBrun manifolds from the noncompact Taub-NUT-AdS space.

Three such distinguishing features exist. First, the Pontryagin class p_1(Lambda^2_+) = 2chi + 3tau integrates to 2A/3 on the closed manifold; on any region where the SD forms are basic (pulled back from the collapse base of dimension at most 3), the integrand Omega_E wedge Omega_E vanishes. So the nonzero topological charge must localize on non-basic regions: NUT points, nil/bundle twist, singular fibers, or genuinely 4D cores. Each such region carries a definite amount of curvature energy from Chern-Weil, and the total int|Rm|^2 budget is bounded by topology. If each NUT-type region requires a minimum energy quantum, the number of such regions is bounded, their total volume is controlled, and the remaining volume must be carried by regions where the covering does unwrap—which are already excluded by the projector obstruction. This energy-budget argument is the most promising path but requires precise Chern-Weil localization estimates that have not yet been developed.

Second, the Weitzenbock gradient energy provides a new structural constraint. Through systematic numerical testing of five candidate Bochner-Weitzenbock conventions against the known parallel Kahler form on a KE surface, this step identified Convention B (Besse Theorem 1.155) as the correct one and computed: for the simple eigenform at the calibrated spectrum, int|nabla H|^2 = int|H|^2, and for the double eigenspace, int|nabla H|^2 = 3/2 int|H|^2. The key is that R-tilde (using the R_{ikjl} index arrangement) has eigenvalues {-1/2, -1/4, -1/4} on Lambda^2_+, which are NOT the usual W+ + s/12 values. This proves the near-harmonic self-dual forms are definitively not nearly parallel—their covariant derivative energy equals their amplitude energy. The TTCS generator analysis then showed rank-dependent consequences: on flat rank-2 or rank-3 regular collapse, closedness plus constant amplitude forces the forms parallel, contradicting the gradient energy. This excludes flat torus collapse of rank at least 2 but leaves rank-1 and nil-twisted models open (a single form reduces to a weighted harmonic 1-form on the 3D base, which can accommodate O(1) horizontal rotation).

Third, the monopole near-saturation structure—multiple independent near-harmonic forms with Walsh-type spatial orthogonality—could potentially force local Gram nondegeneracy, which by the definite-triple mechanism would exclude all collapse. But the Walsh estimates give only L^1 orthogonality and phase separation, not pointwise nondegeneracy. Upgrading this requires connecting the eigenline deviation estimates from the Codex decomposition to local Gram lower bounds, which is an unsolved analytic problem.

The positive branch faces a parallel collapse barrier: S0910A02's Cheeger-Naber finiteness theorem converts the Sha-Yang family into a sharp dichotomy (uniform pinching gap or total volume collapse), but the collapse alternative remains substantive. The two branches share the structural feature that covering noncollapse is the single load-bearing hypothesis. The NUT-type obstruction applies to both signs (Taub-NUT-AdS has negative Einstein constant, but positive analogues exist on CP^2-type spaces). Whether the positive and negative branches can be attacked simultaneously through their shared collapse structure is an unexplored possibility.

The research is still in Explore because the central mathematical bridge—from closed-manifold topology to covering noncollapse or its impossibility—has not been constructed. The accumulated tools (projector obstruction, cover-mean transport, maximal-function selection, Weitzenbock gradient energy, Pontryagin localization, form-rank analysis, orbit-volume equations) are all valid and increasingly precise, but they terminate at the covering noncollapse step. The next decisive work must either close this gap using manifold-specific topology or identify that the gap cannot be closed, which would shift the research toward constructing counterexamples or alternative approaches entirely.

## Deep-Reasoning

本步重新定位了四维负支塌缩问题的核心。Step 9 把 Taub–NUT–AdS 解释为局部覆盖正则性的一般反模型，但缓冲域本身是几何数据：先取包含 NUT 的大域再限制其万有覆盖，与先取不含 NUT 的小域再取万有覆盖并不相同。精确计算表明，距 NUT 为 1/2 的点只在半径不超过 1/3 的环带球上有一致曲率均值；半径超过 1/2 后，球捕获曲率为 O(ν^{-4}) 的核心，其平均曲率能量按 O(ν^{-1}) 发散。较小固定缓冲域会展开 Hopf 圆，所得非塌缩极限是截面曲率 -1/3 的实双曲四维空间，而其标量–Weyl 配方余量等于 16。因此 Taub–NUT–AdS 既不满足好点的全尺度曲率均值输入，也不满足校准余量趋零；它揭示覆盖对缓冲域的依赖，却没有否定可调整缓冲尺度的覆盖路线。

精确 Weyl 计算进一步把这个修正变成可复算事实。对所用 Taub–NUT–AdS 规范，Ric=-g，四指标范数满足 |W|²=32ν²(4ν²-3)²/[3(r+ν)^6]。在脚本取向下 W+=0，W- 的本征值为两个 2ν(4ν²-3)/[3(r+ν)^3] 和一个 -4ν(4ν²-3)/[3(r+ν)^3]；NUT 处 |W|²约为3/(2ν⁴)，总 full-Weyl 能量趋于32π²。由此可见，标准 NUT 核在核心尺度因曲率均值过大而离开好点，在固定环带又因校准余量为16而离开好点。若仍存在逃逸机制，它必须在所有固定尺度维持校准 Weyl 轮廓，同时通过嵌套收缩核、模型退化或弥散扭曲持续破坏最大秩；熟悉的单个 NUT 帽不是这种对象。

同一修正澄清了尺度结构。若 ĝ=a²g，Ricci 与 Weyl 的相应曲率端同态按 a^{-2} 缩放。将半径 r 的球放大到单位尺度后，禁止谱变为 (-r²/6,r²/12,r²/12)，并非保持原数值。更一般地，Ric=-κg 与谱 (-κ/6,κ/12,κ/12) 的常谱局部几何会同时满足投影恒等式给出的 ∇W+=0，以及 Einstein–Weyl 公式要求的 |∇W+|²=κ³/16；对每个固定 κ>0 都矛盾。只有可用覆盖尺度趋零、κ随之趋零时，这一局部矛盾才退化。因此负支真正需要的是依赖曲率均值 K 的正尺度下界，而不是任意趋零尺度上的展开。

Pontryagin 结构提供了比计数 NUT 核更贴合近饱和序列的入口。Levi–Civita 在 Λ²_+ 上的特征密度 ρ_+=(1/(4π²))(s²/24+2|W+|²-|Ric°|²/2) 满足 ||ρ_+-3/(16π²)||_{L¹}→0。于是任何可测区域上的特征质量都渐近等于常数乘其四维体积；趋零体积的核心不可能承载全部质量。若把 Levi–Civita 联络 A 与低维基底拉回的 basic/split 联络 B 比较，则 P(F_A)-P(F_B)=dT_P(A,B)，且基底维数不超过3时 P(F_B)=0。正体积塌缩主体必须持续产生非 basic 的 Chern–Simons 通量。

在适配的圆塌缩区写 F_A=F_H+η∧Ξ、Ξ=i_VF_A，水平维数为3使 P(F_A)=2η∧P(Ξ,F_H)。Cauchy–Schwarz 与 ρ_+ 的正密度说明：若水平曲率均值受 K 控制，则 Ξ 的平方均值有正下界。这个结果严格排除了 basic collapse，却没有排除塌缩本身。若纤维长度为 ℓ，Ξ 可含 ℓ^{-1}D_HΦ、O’Neill 张量、nil 交换子及垂直标架扭曲；普通 holonomy 可以只变化 O(ℓ)，而尺度化 holonomy 仍以 O(1) 速率变化。因此特征质量可以弥散在塌缩主体中，不必形成整数化的局部电荷。下一项高价值数学工作是把 Ξ 分解为固定尺度可展开部分、短纤维收缩填充所需的曲率以及 O’Neill/nil 扭曲，并把其正能量与全尺度小校准余量结合。

这与会话组的其他结果形成一致图景。S0910A02 的相反 warping Calderón–Zygmund 尖峰说明，C⁰ Ricci 小量与小 L² 曲率能量不能直接产生点态 Riemann 控制；后续必须依靠缓冲覆盖上的调和坐标、有限 p 估计、平滑化或弱积分恒等式。S0910A01 的 basic-collapse Pontryagin 观察与本步的弥散密度计算相符，但局部自对偶形式的平行化一般需要良态三重组，不能仅凭一对形式完成。四维负临界族仍只是完整 Yau 第26题的试验场：原命题 Q_n 等价于正、负归一化分支的析取；否定固定维数的 Q_n 需要两支都失败，但两支可以由不同流形见证。此前要求同一流形同时承载两类输入是不必要的加强。正支、高维与 Lean 形式化仍远未完成，当前成果的价值在于把负支的剩余对象从模糊的全局拓扑问题压缩为固定尺度秩恢复与弥散非 basic 曲率之间的精确竞争。

## Deep-Reasoning

This step developed the static circle reduction of W⁺ for Einstein four-manifolds with Ric = -g, discovered and corrected a significant formula error through TTCS verification, and established a clean fiber survival dichotomy that reshapes the negative-branch collapse program.

The central mathematical construction is the static circle reduction: for g = g_B + ℓ²dψ² with Ric = -g, the self-dual Weyl operator satisfies Spec(W⁺) = {1/3 - η_i} where η_i are eigenvalues of h = Hess(ℓ)/ℓ with tr(h) = 1. The initial derivation used an incorrect factor (the '2J(h - I/3)' formula), which was caught by the TTCS verifier through a careful index-by-index recomputation using the three-dimensional Riemann-Ricci identity and the trace constraint. The corrected formula—confirmed against constant curvature (gives W⁺ = 0) and Taub-NUT-AdS (static part + twist = 0)—changes the calibrated Hessian eigenvalues from (3/8, 3/8, 1/4) to (1/2, 1/4, 1/4). The cohomogeneity-one incompatibility strengthens: the Einstein ODE system gives a'' = a/4 from the radial equation but a'' = a/2 from differentiating the angular constraint, with relative gap 1/2.

Two additional corrections matter. First, the twist sign: the modified Laplacian Δ_B ℓ + (ℓ³/4)|F|² = ℓ gives tr(h) = 1 + ℓ²|F|²/4 > 1, not < 1. Second and more importantly: near a smooth NUT where ℓ → 0, both h and the twist correction diverge individually (h_ang ~ 1/(8νx), ℓ²|F|² ~ 1/(2νx)) while canceling in the smooth total curvature. The earlier claim that 'the static formula dominates near the NUT, forcing W⁺ toward 0' is therefore false. In principle, a NUT with appropriate twist cancellation could maintain any W⁺ eigenvalue structure.

These corrections refine but do not destroy the collapse obstruction program. The valid structural result is the fiber survival dichotomy from the TTCS generator analysis. On the calibrated good set, either (S) the circle fiber survives at a fixed buffer scale—in which case a buffered normal cover unwraps it, the mean transport carries the calibrated deficit, and the forbidden Einstein germ (Steps 5-6) gives a contradiction—or (D) the fiber dies within every fixed buffer scale, which requires persistent high twist ℓ²|F|² ≥ c > 0 to maintain the calibrated W⁺ anisotropy against the static incompatibility. The generator further showed that ℓ(p) can be arbitrarily small at a good point (a multiplicative rescaling ℓ → εℓ doesn't change h), so the curvature-mean bound controls h, not ℓ itself. But in the non-degenerate case, Harnack for the positive eigenfunction equation Δ_B ℓ = (1 + τ/4)ℓ prevents ℓ from dying within a controlled neighborhood.

The Strategist's correction about the Pontryagin density is fully validated: for any Einstein metric with Ric = -g, the Levi-Civita connection on Λ²₊ has self-dual curvature, giving |ι_V F|² = |F|²/2 automatically. The isotropic scalar contribution s²/24 provides 88.9% of the calibrated characteristic density. The distinguishing feature is not the density magnitude but the W⁺ anisotropy (|W⁺|² = 1/24 vs 0).

S0910A02's toric orthogonal transitivity result connects directly to our dichotomy: their conserved twist constants vanish at degeneration edges, forcing static structure near bolts/edges. If this extends to approximate settings, it would push case (D) back toward case (S) near fiber death points. S0910A01's rank-one Cartan structure analysis supports the diffuse mixed-curvature picture. The three sessions now have complementary results that should be combined to attack the remaining high-twist case.

The positive branch, higher dimensions, and Lean formalization remain substantially open. The current work provides a significantly refined but still incomplete negative-branch analysis.

## Deep-Reasoning

本步重写了四维负支塌缩问题的核心表示。Step 11 把固定尺度纤维存活与持续高扭曲组织成二分，但这混合了三种不同现象：完整 T² 作用的极性不等于所选圆作用的静态性；小的 Z=ℓF 不控制 ∇Z；商空间的退化也不能由普通 Harnack 估计排除。Taub–NUT–AdS 在精确 Einstein 情形中同时展示前两点：其 T² 作用可极化，而 Hopf 圆仍有非零联络曲率；静态电部分与含导数的磁部分精确抵消。H²×H² 又给出静态常谱反例，Hess ℓ/ℓ 的谱为 (1,0,0)，W⁺ 的谱为 (-2/3,1/3,1/3)，所以 Step 11 只有球面对称共维一计算成立，不能扩展成一般静态分类。一般校准常谱的排除仍来自 Step 6 的 Einstein–Weyl 投影论证。

在正则圆约化 g=q+ℓ²θ² 上，本步采用 u=d logℓ、Z=ℓF、z=*qZ 和 H=Hess_qℓ/ℓ，得到精确负 Einstein 约化结构。电、磁 Weyl 张量可写为 E=κI/3-H+(|z|²I-z⊗z)/4 与 B=[sym∇z+u⊗z+z⊗u-〈u,z〉I]/2；约化方程给出 tr H=κ+|z|²/2、dz=-2u∧z、div z=〈u,z〉，而 W⁺、W⁻ 在取向选择下分别为 E+B、E-B。这里 Z 的大小只进入 E 的代数二次项，∇z 与 u⊗z 则直接进入 B，因此 Z→0 不产生静态极限。

新的结构性结果是手征 Riccati 分解。令 a₊=u-z/2、a₋=u+z/2，则在交换取向的可能性下，W⁺=-[sym∇a₊+a₊⊗a₊]₀，W⁻=-[sym∇a₋+a₋⊗a₋]₀，并且 da₊=a₊∧a₋、da₋=-a₊∧a₋。校准余量控制一个手征组合的无迹 Riccati 张量，全曲率均值则控制两个组合；但迹方向、u 与 z 的相消以及商度量本身仍可能退化。因此真正缺少的不是另一个共维一排除，而是对耦合 Riccati–Maurer–Cartan 系统的加权紧性与四维重建理论。

两项精确模型核对增强了这一表示。脚本在 Taub–NUT–AdS 上得到 E=diag(-2c,c,c)、B=diag(2c,-c,-c)，从而 E+B=0，E-B 的谱与此前坐标曲率计算完全相同；在 H²×H² 上则复现静态非零常谱。符号恒等式由两个独立脚本复算通过。外部来源进一步给出两个可继承结构：Geroch 的 Killing 范数–扭势方程显示正规区域中的完整系统确为耦合椭圆系统，但在 ℓ→0 时系数奇化；Galaz-García–Kell–Mondino–Sosa 说明真正圆作用的商连同推前体积继承 RCD*(K,4)，光滑部分对应 Ric_q-Hessℓ/ℓ≥Kq。这个有限维加权 Ricci 量正是四维水平 Ricci 自然控制的组合，而不是普通 Ric_q；这解释了先前商空间调和半径和普通 Harnack 推论为何没有来源。

由此，固定尺度可达性现在分成两个相连但尚未完成的数学层次：先从仅有 Ricci 控制的塌缩序列得到足够精确的局部圆或幂零结构，再对加权商空间上的完整 u,z 系统证明固定尺度重建。Ye Li 的四维平滑化定理提供了另一接口：若 r⁴ Vol(B_r)^{-1}∫|Rm|² 足够小，可在无非塌缩输入下获得短时有界曲率；然而校准主体具有非零背景曲率密度，我们目前只有归一化能量有界而非足够小。一个更贴合当前结构的可能创新是对移动的 Λ²₊ 校准谱投影或手征 Riccati 余量建立协变平滑化理论。若成立，它可能绕过先构造精确圆作用；若导数扭曲模型能破坏它，则会明确指出负支应转向何种退化几何。TTCS 本步两项任务均未返回可用内容，因此上述新分解目前由逐式代数、两个精确模型和实际来源支撑，仍值得下一步独立复核。完整 Yau 第26题仍远未完成，正支、高维及 Lean 形式化均未由本步处理。

## Deep-Reasoning

This step achieved a qualitative advance in the four-dimensional negative-branch collapse program by identifying and developing an L\u00b2 Sobolev absorption mechanism that resolves the central stability gap for the Einstein defect through Ye Li smoothing. The advance connects three previously separate strands: the Strategist's small-radius observation, the normalized Ricci flow evolution of the Einstein defect, and the 4D relative Sobolev inequality.

The governing problem since Step 6 has been fixed-scale accessibility: a hypothetical near-critical sequence on a fixed Ishida\u2013LeBrun manifold must collapse everywhere at unit scale (by the projector/Derdzinski forbidden germ), but total volume remains positive, so diameter diverges. The question is whether the collapsing structure can be made precise enough to derive a contradiction. Steps 7\u201312 developed orbit-volume equations, cover transport, Taub\u2013NUT corrections, Pontryagin density, and the chiral Riccati reduction, but each route encountered the same fundamental barrier: bounded Ricci does not give bounded full curvature, so the reduced equations have uncontrolled coefficients, and naive curvature-averaging on covers or quotients fails.

Ye Li\u2019s 4D smoothing theorem (Thm 3.6) breaks this barrier by producing bounded sectional curvature from bounded Ricci plus small dimensionless energy, without a noncollapse hypothesis. The Strategist\u2019s key observation is that at maximal-function good points, the dimensionless energy r\u2074\u2009fint|Rm|\u00b2 \u2264 K\u2080r\u2074 becomes arbitrarily small by reducing the fixed physical radius r\u2080. This does NOT send the Einstein scale to zero (r\u2080 is fixed before i\u2192\u221e) and does NOT require the calibrated background curvature to vanish. Bishop\u2013Gromov extends the small-energy condition to every center in B_{r\u2080/2}(p), supplying Li\u2019s all-centers hypothesis on a buffered ball.

The new mathematical content is the L\u00b2 propagation of the Einstein defect E = Ric+g through the smoothing flow. Under the normalized flow \u2202_t g = -2(Ric+g), the evolution \u2202_t E = \u0394_L E - 2E gives (\u2202_t-\u0394)|E|\u00b2 = -2|\u2207E|\u00b2 + 4R_{ikjl}E_{ij}E_{kl}. The TTCS verifier confirmed both identities and corrected the misleading claim that -2E provides net damping in the scalar equation (it cancels exactly against metric-variation and Lichnerowicz terms). The pointwise Gronwall estimate fails because |Rm| \u2264 C/t gives a divergent integral \u222b C/t dt. However, the L\u00b2 estimate circumvents this:

\u222b|Rm||\u03c6E|\u00b2 \u2264 \u2016Rm\u2016_{L\u00b2}\u2016\u03c6E\u2016_{L\u2074}\u00b2

Using the 4D relative Sobolev inequality \u2016f\u2016_{L\u2074}\u00b2 \u2264 C_S V^{-1/2}(r\u00b2\u2016\u2207f\u2016\u2082\u00b2+\u2016f\u2016\u2082\u00b2), the volume V cancels between \u2016Rm\u2016_{L\u00b2}=V^{1/2}(fint|Rm|\u00b2)^{1/2} and V^{-1/2} from Sobolev. The resulting coefficient is C_S\u00b7\u03b5_r^{1/2} where \u03b5_r = r\u2080\u2074 fint|Rm|\u00b2 is SMALL. For \u03b5_r small enough, the curvature reaction is absorbed by the gradient dissipation -2\u222b|\u2207E|\u00b2, giving d/dt \u222b\u03c6\u00b2|E|\u00b2 \u2264 C r\u2080\u207b\u00b2 \u222b|E|\u00b2. Over time t\u2080 = O(r\u2080\u00b2), the Gronwall factor is e^C (fixed constant). The parabolic mean-value inequality at time t\u2080 (where |Rm|\u2264K) then upgrades L\u00b2 to pointwise, with volumes cancelling in the ratio, giving sup|E(t\u2080)| \u2264 C*\u03b4_i \u2192 0.

The numerical verification with conservative parameters gives absorption coefficient 0.71<1, L\u00b2 growth factor 1.03, and pointwise amplification factor ~7.2. The smoothed metric simultaneously has bounded curvature AND small Einstein defect\u2014the complete input for the forbidden germ.

The TTCS generator independently analyzed whether the calibrated W\u207a spectrum forces H = Hess(\u2113)/\u2113 \u2265 0 on the quotient base. The sharp result is H \u2265 (1/4)I + B, where B is the magnetic Weyl block. A 1-jet model achieves negative H-eigenvalue for |B|>1/4, but the cost enters |W\u207b|\u00b2. After smoothing, |B| \u2264 C(K) is bounded, so H \u2265 -(C-1/4)I, giving bounded base Ricci in 3D (hence bounded full base curvature), base harmonic radius, and 4D KK chart. This eliminates the H\u22650 gap from A01\u2019s bootstrap.

The remaining technical gap is localizing Li\u2019s all-centers theorem to a buffered ball. Li\u2019s proof uses a covering argument within B_{3r/2}(x) (lines 331\u2013335 of the source), which only requires nearby-center comparisons. A local version for a buffered domain should follow by conformal completion or doubling, but this has not been verified against the full proof. A01 independently reached the same localization question in Step 14. The L\u00b2 propagation mechanism I developed resolves A01\u2019s second bridge (preserving E through the flow) and supersedes Step 12\u2019s incorrect dismissal of smoothing. The calibrated W\u207a transfer needs separate treatment: the Chern\u2013Weil and Seiberg\u2013Witten identities apply to any metric on the fixed topology, so the profile analysis applies to g_i(t\u2080) as well, provided |E(t\u2080)| is small (which it now is).

The positive branch, dimensions n\u22655, a complete proof or counterexample to Yau 26, and Lean formalization remain open. The current work is strictly four-dimensional and negative-branch.

## Deep-Reasoning

This step changed the smoothing route from an announced closure into a precise and substantially stronger analytic program. The Step 13 inner/outer energy inequality was not closed: an estimate of the form \(Y'_{\rm inner}\le Cr^{-2}Y_{\rm outer}\) does not yield Gronwall control of \(Y_{\rm inner}\), and persistence of the small normalized curvature energy during the flow had not been established. The previous numerical absorption factors tested only algebra. Those statements were explicitly superseded in the research record.

Ye Li's Corollary 3.5 supplies the correct defect-propagation mechanism once its dynamic hypotheses are available. For the normalized Einstein defect \(E=\operatorname{Ric}+g\), the exact evolution remains
\[
\partial_tE=\Delta_LE-2E,\qquad
(\partial_t-\Delta)|E|^2=-2|\nabla E|^2+4\operatorname{Rm}(E,E).
\]
Regularizing \(|E|\) by \(u_\eta=(|E|^2+\eta)^{1/2}\) gives
\[
(\partial_t-\Delta)u_\eta\le2|\operatorname{Rm}|u_\eta.
\]
After the exact conversion from normalized to unnormalized Ricci flow, Corollary 3.5 applies to the corresponding tensor \(H=\operatorname{Ric}_{\bar g}+(1+2s)^{-1}\bar g\). Its four-dimensional Sobolev coefficient satisfies \(A\lesssim r^2/\operatorname{Vol}(B_r)^{1/2}\). This cancels the volume both in the critical curvature-energy input and in the initial \(L^3\) defect term, yielding the sharp conditional estimate
\[
|E(x,t)|\le C\delta r^{4/3}t^{-2/3}=C\delta(r^2/t)^{2/3}.
\]
The singularity is integrable, so the normalized metric drift is at most \(C\delta r^{4/3}t^{1/3}\), hence \(O(\delta r^2)\) at time \(t=\theta r^2\). This is collapse-uniform and avoids the divergent pointwise \(C/t\) Gronwall argument.

The source scope is now clear. Li's Theorem 3.1 explicitly assumes small critical energy for every centre on the complete manifold, and Theorem 3.6 inherits that quantifier when it restates the theorem using normalized energy. Li's proof propagates curvature energy, Sobolev inequalities, metric equivalence, and an \(L^3\) curvature-potential estimate through a supremum over centres and bounded-overlap coverings. A maximal-function good point supplies the initial all-centres condition only inside a buffered region. Thus the defect estimate is proved under Li's global setting or under an independently constructed local flow carrying the same dynamic structure, but the published theorem does not by itself construct that collapsed local flow. The printed \(\phi^2\) in Corollary 3.5 is incompatible with its undefined notation, Theorem 2.5, and Li's subsequent use for ordinary Ricci flow; the source-consistent version is the ordinary subsolution inequality without that factor.

A normalized cutoff flow on the original closed manifold now provides the most coherent localization interface. For \(a=\chi^2\) and \(\partial_tg=-2aE\), direct variation gives
\[
\partial_tE=a(\Delta_LE-2E)+\mathcal C_a(E),
\]
where every term of \(\mathcal C_a(E)\) contains \(E\), \(\operatorname{tr}E\), or their first derivatives. Therefore an exact negative Einstein metric is stationary even in the transition annulus; no collar source independent of \(E\) appears. In the integrated defect energy, contracted Bianchi and integration by parts remove all Hessians of \(a\). The identity \(|d(\chi^2)|^2/\chi^2=4|d\chi|^2\) prevents a \(1/\chi\) loss, leaving only multiplicative transition terms such as \(|d\chi|^2|E|^2\). This homogeneity was checked symbolically in `workspace/scripts/verify_cutoff_defect_energy.py` with exit code 0.

Yang-Wang local Ricci flow theory confirms that compactly supported equations \(\partial_tg=-2\chi^2\operatorname{Ric}\) exist and possess critical curvature-energy estimates, while Fei He's work states that parallel normalized arguments use \(\operatorname{Ric}-\lambda g\). These sources support the architecture but do not yet furnish the exact theorem needed here: Wang assumes a global Sobolev coefficient and global small \(L^{n/2}\) energy on the cutoff support, while He assumes pointwise full-curvature scales and initial derivatives of the Ricci defect. The present sequence instead has local normalized energy on buffered good regions and no initial full-curvature or derivative bound. The remaining analytic object is consequently a bounded-overlap, collapse-uniform curvature-energy bootstrap for \(\partial_tg=-2\chi^2(\operatorname{Ric}+g)\), not further numerical testing on exact Einstein examples.

Localization and calibrated Weyl information must remain coupled. A cutoff flow on the original closed topology is preferable to completion or doubling because a global \(O(\delta_i)\) defect estimate lets the Ishida-LeBrun Chern-Weil and monopole near-saturation argument be rerun on the evolved closed metric without additive collar error. Yet global small calibrated deficit alone does not guarantee low normalized deficit in one preselected collapsed ball. A successful construction should smooth a positive-volume portion of the joint curvature/deficit good set, with bounded overlap and homogeneous global defect propagation, so the global deficit can select a bounded-curvature region with low local normalized deficit. After that, collapsed bounded-curvature reconstruction remains a separate geometric problem; bounded magnetic Weyl data does not control all quotient coefficients, and bounded sectional curvature alone does not create a noncollapsed harmonic chart. The complete Yau Problem 26, the positive branch, dimensions at least five, and Lean formalization remain far beyond this four-dimensional critical negative-branch advance.

## Deep-Reasoning

Step 16 overturns the Step 15 conclusion that a fixed critical Ishida–LeBrun manifold has a proved negative Ricci-pinching gap. The failure is mathematical rather than bibliographic. Li’s curvature-energy argument propagates a supremum over every center in its working domain. Centers near the boundary require neighboring balls outside that domain; restricting the supremum to an inner plateau merely restores the uncontrolled inner/outer energy inequality. Ricci flow also has no finite propagation speed, so a buffer much larger than √t does not make transition data irrelevant. A maximal-function estimate at one center controls radius-r balls only through a fixed multiple of r, not a much larger plateau. The fixed-topology gap is therefore withdrawn.

The metric-by-metric inequality
∫(|W⁺|−1/(2√6))² ≤ (7/24)∫|Ric+g|²
remains sound. It converts terminal global L² Einstein-defect control into the calibrated Weyl modulus on any smooth metric on the same critical topology, but supplies no evolution estimate. The actual parabolic problem must include the full support of a=χ². The defect energy has no E-independent source and no intrinsic 1/χ loss because |da|²/a=4|dχ|². Curvature evolution adds ∇²a·E·Rm and ∇a·∇E·Rm. The latter can only be handled by coupling curvature energy to the weighted ∫a|∇E|² dissipation. This leads to local energies Rα and Pα with a whole-support finite-neighbor system; a large combination Rα+κPα is the natural quantity. Yet this system is not a theorem from the present initial data because metric equivalence, evolving relative Sobolev inequalities, the covariant Hessian of χ, and an integrable pointwise estimate for aE depend on one another. Direct reading of Wang confirms this circle: evolving cutoff Hessians and ∇(χ²Rm) are coupled, while the sourced pointwise-curvature result assumes global Sobolev and full-support critical energy. A promising way to break the circle is a Yang-type Moser estimate ||aE(t)||∞ ≤ C_p δ(r²/t)^(2/p), p>2. Its singularity is integrable, and the relative-Sobolev volume factors have the correct four-dimensional cancellation under collapse, but this estimate still must be derived for the normalized cutoff equation on the entire active support.

A substantial downstream simplification was proved. If a positive-volume center set P lies in a uniformly buffered region with |sec|≤K and r<π/(2√K), exponential pullbacks h_p=exp_p* g give noncollapsed radius-r balls even when exp_p is highly noninjective. Rauch comparison and invariance of Liouville measure yield
∫_P avg_{B_r(0),h_p}(F∘exp_p) dp ≤ C(n,K,r)∫F,
where C is the ratio of the hyperbolic and spherical radial model-volume integrals. Sheet number and injectivity radius never enter because geodesic flow retains terminal direction. Thus terminal global nonnegative deficits can select a fixed-radius regular pullback chart without a theorem about CFG rank strata or normal-cover accessibility. Positive-time curvature-derivative estimates, or another sufficiently strong compactness mechanism, are still needed to pass curvature smoothly.

The harmonic-form passage was also repaired. Unique continuation has no quantitative local-mass content and cannot stop normalized harmonic forms from vanishing on selected charts. At the evolved metric one must reconstruct its sign monopole class, harmonic representative, spinor, and rescaled monopole. The scalar–Weyl weight q=√6|W⁺|−s may change sign when only terminal L² defect is known. Setting r=q⁺ repairs this: smooth positive weights with f² approximating r+ε satisfy inf L⁺(f)=∫r², and the exact nonnegative deficit decomposition acquires the favorable term ∫q⁻u²; no derivatives of f occur. Consequently q⁻, harmonic-amplitude error, and lowest-eigenline error are controlled by the terminal defect. A joint density containing |E|², (q⁺−9/2)², harmonic-amplitude error, and ⟨(W⁺+√(2/3)|W⁺|I)H,H⟩ can be fed into the exponential-chart averaging lemma. On a smoothly convergent selected chart it produces a nonzero limiting harmonic form in the extremal lowest eigenline, hence the calibrated spectrum (−1/6,1/12,1/12) needed by the established Step 6 local contradiction.

This reorganizes the fixed-topology program. Collapse classification and unique continuation are no longer necessary downstream prerequisites; the difficult center is now concentrated in one transition-inclusive local-flow theorem that must simultaneously produce a positive-volume bounded-curvature buffer, terminal global L² defect control, metric equivalence, and derivative estimates. Even success there would settle only the fixed critical four-dimensional negative laboratory. Dimension-only constants across changing topology, the unrestricted positive branch, dimensions at least five, and Lean formalization remain far from the full Yau Problem 26 goal. The peer toric positive work supplies useful invariant identities but presently has no reduction from arbitrary metrics to invariant ones.

## Deep-Reasoning

This step developed the transition-inclusive normalized cutoff-flow theorem for the 4D negative-branch program. The central mathematical advance is the proof that the coupled L² curvature-defect energy system closes independently under the 4D Sobolev-energy cancellation mechanism, without requiring pointwise curvature bounds as input.

The key algebraic finding was that the defect evolution identity is cleaner than initially thought: the cubic term tr(E³) fully cancels because the inverse-metric variation ∂_t g^{ij} = 2aE^{ij} contributes +4a tr(E³) that exactly cancels the -4a tr(E³) from the Lichnerowicz/damping interaction. The correct identity (∂_t - aΔ)|E|² = -2a|∇E|² + 4a Rm(E,E) + 2⟨E, C_a(E)⟩ has no explicit cubic defect reaction — it is precisely the Step 14 identity, providing a consistency check.

However, TTCS verification identified an important correction to the original Proposition 1: the maximum principle for |E|² still requires ||a Rm(g(t))||_∞ as input. C⁰ metric closeness does not control curvature (a second-derivative quantity), so the initial K₀ cannot simply be inserted. The maximum principle thus breaks only one direction of the continuation circle: given a weighted curvature bound (e.g. Li's C/t on the plateau or a degenerate ε-regularity result on the transition), defect preservation and metric equivalence follow unconditionally.

The most important new result is the closure of the coupled L² energy system. Define H_α = R_α + κP_α (with R_α the normalized curvature energy and P_α the normalized defect energy on the α-th cover element). The critical absorption mechanism — that C_S · ||Rm||_{L²} = O(√ε*) in 4D — absorbs the dangerous ∫|Rm||E|² reaction and the transition cross terms ∫|∇a|·|∇E|·|Rm|. The resulting closed inequality dH_α/dt ≤ Cr^{-2} Σ_{β~α} H_β gives H_*(t) ≤ e^{CNθ} H_*(0), establishing critical curvature-energy persistence with volume-independent constants. A01 independently developed the same Sobolev-energy mechanism in their Step 17 Section 5.5; the two derivations agree.

A key structural observation from the Strategist is that the volume-normalized form extends the result's reach beyond fixed topology. Under the critical near-Einstein profile, Vol(M) ~ 32π²A/9 and ∫|Rm|² ≤ 8π²χ + CVol, so K̄ = Vol⁻¹∫|Rm|² ≤ C(1 + χ/A). For critical Ishida-LeBrun families built from BMY-bounded surfaces of general type, χ/A ≥ 1/3 is automatic. Thus K̄ is uniformly bounded, r* is universal, and the entire construction has dimension-only constants. If the remaining gap is closed, the result would be a uniform negative-pinching gap across all such families, not merely a fixed-topology gap.

The precisely identified remaining gap is the degenerate ε-regularity problem: going from L² energy smallness (R_α ≤ 2ε*) to weighted pointwise curvature bounds (||aRm||_∞ ≤ C/t) under the degenerate operator ∂_t - aΔ. On the plateau (a = 1), this is exactly Li's Theorem 3.4. On the transition (0 < a < 1), a new argument is needed — either a degenerate Moser iteration or an alternative regularity mechanism that handles the χ²-weighted diffusion. The correct proof hierarchy would be: L² energy → degenerate ε-regularity → maximum principle for defect → metric equivalence → Li smoothing on plateau → Corollary 3.5 defect decay → L² calibration → exponential chart → forbidden germ.

## Deep-Reasoning

Step 18 repaired the logical order of the four-dimensional negative-branch cutoff-flow program and isolated a sharper analytic mechanism. The Step 17 picture of a completed integral layer followed by one transition regularity problem was too strong. Coupled curvature–defect L² estimates use evolving metric comparability, relative Sobolev inequalities, fixed ball and overlap geometry, cutoff control, and small neighboring energies. They can improve energy bounds inside a simultaneous first-exit argument, but cannot independently produce all those inputs.

The proposed maximum-principle route also fails at the initial slice. Even if one proves |aRm(t)|≤C/t for a=χ², the coefficient in the defect maximum principle has divergent integral ∫₀ᵀdt/t. Beginning at t₀>0 yields a factor (T/t₀)^C, with no sequence-uniform passage to t₀=0 because the initial metrics have only curvature-mean control. Moreover, the covariant Hessian of a evolves with the connection; fixing χ as a scalar function does not keep Hess a bounded. Metric motion must instead be controlled directly through an integrable estimate for the velocity aE.

The main new structural result comes from weighting the Einstein defect before performing higher-power estimates. With E=Ric+g and U=aE, commuting a through the Laplacian cancels the terms a(Δa)E and 2a∇a·∇E exactly. The resulting tensor equation has only Hessian-a, first-gradient, curvature, and lower-order homogeneous terms. Apparent quotients by a are regular because da⊗da/a=4dχ⊗dχ. In a localized tensor Lᵖ calculation, Hessian-a terms can be integrated by parts and absorbed using the full tensor dissipation; scalar Kato reduction alone would lose rotational components of ∇U. The resulting inequality has the form

d/dt ∫η²|U|ᵖ + cₚ∫η²a|∇|U|^(p/2)|² ≤ cutoff terms + Cₚ∫η²a|Rm||U|ᵖ + Cₚ∫η²|U|^(p+1).

On a relative-Sobolev ball, both reactions are estimated through χη|U|^(p/2). In dimension four the product of the relative Sobolev coefficient with the local L² curvature norm is the square root of the normalized critical energy, so collapsed volume cancels. Consequently, for any one fixed p>2, sufficiently small local curvature and defect energies yield conditional propagation of the spatial supercritical norm: the local average of |aE|ᵖ remains bounded by Cₚδᵖ throughout the provisional first-exit interval. This cannot be repeated unchanged as p tends to infinity because the reaction-to-dissipation coefficient grows with p; a fixed energy threshold cannot absorb every stage.

The correct second stage follows Li and Yang: treat curvature as a time-dependent potential. A sufficient transition estimate is S_α⁴∫a|Rm|³≤C/t, where S_α is the norm-form relative Sobolev coefficient; the stronger |aRm|≤C/t plus persistent local L² curvature energy implies it. Starting from the fixed supercritical norm, a time-cylinder iteration would then give |aE(t)|≤Cₚδ(r²/t)^(2/p). ## Deep-Reasoning

This step resolved the question of whether the 4D Sobolev-energy cancellation extends from the coupled L² energy system to the curvature-potential mechanism needed for closing the cutoff-flow first-exit. The answer is structurally yes: Wang's critical parameter β = A₀²·‖Rm‖_{L^{n/2}} is volume-independent in every dimension (β = C²r²K₀^{2/n}), and in 4D the L² energy IS the critical L^{n/2} exponent, so the available Chern-Weil/maximal-function data directly supplies β = C√ε_Li small. This means the 4D volume cancellation is not a separate miracle but the same mechanism operating at the curvature-potential level rather than the defect-energy level.

The second important finding is the p > 4 threshold for connection and cutoff-Hessian drift integrability. If the weighted defect satisfies |χ²E(t)| ≤ C_pδ(r²/t)^{2/p}, then the companion derivative estimate |χ∇(χ²E)(t)| ≤ C_pδt^{-1/2}(r²/t)^{2/p} is time-integrable if and only if p > 4. The metric drift requires only p > 2; the derivative/connection drift requires the strictly stronger p > 4 condition. For p = 6, both metric drift ~ δθ^{2/3}r² and connection drift ~ δθ^{1/6} are simultaneously O(δ) with dimension-only constants. This separates two genuinely different analytic demands and shows that a single fixed p > 4 (e.g., p = 6) gives simultaneous control of all first-exit quantities.

Independent TTCS verification confirmed both proved results and identified two important corrections. First, the volume cancellation of β is dimension-general, not 4D-specific; what IS 4D-specific is that L² is the critical exponent and Chern-Gauss-Bonnet bounds the mean curvature. Second, Wang's Theorem 6.3 does NOT localize to the finite-neighbor degenerate system by simple restriction: the localization requires an independent treatment of two localization cutoff scales (flow weight χ² and Moser test function η), level-dependent neighbor coupling at each Moser exponent, and evolving measure terms. Li's iteration is local but non-degenerate; Wang's is degenerate but global; the needed hybrid is local AND degenerate.

The TTCS also sharpened the treatment of the normalized-flow correction. The term ∇²(χ²)⊙g from h₂ = -2χ²g is an Rm-independent additive forcing, not merely a lower-order term. For the defect E, the homogeneity C_a(0) = 0 removes this source, but for Rm (needed as curvature potential), the source persists and is controlled only as an O(θK₀V) additive energy over the flow time—absorbed for small θ but requiring explicit treatment.

The current architecture: if both PDE targets (localized degenerate curvature ε-regularity and localized weighted tensor Bernstein) can be proved, the first-exit closes with no circularity. The proof order would be: small energy → Wang/Yang curvature decay → Li curvature potential → defect pointwise estimate → weighted Bernstein derivative → integration at p = 6 → all drift O(δ) → first-exit improved. The volume-independent β removes the collapsed-volume obstruction from the curvature-potential step; the remaining difficulty is purely PDE-localization.

This does NOT solve Yau 26. Even if both targets are proved and the first-exit closes, the result would be: fixed-topology (or Noether-uniform across the standard subclass) negative-pinching gap for critical Ishida-LeBrun 4-manifolds. The unrestricted negative branch, positive branch, dimensions n ≥ 5, dimension-only quantifiers, and Lean formalization remain entirely open.

Step 20 changed the analytic representation of the cutoff-flow problem. The Step 19 idea treated the weighted cubic curvature quantity as though it supplied Li’s unweighted transition potential, but small beta does not remove degeneracy where a=chi² approaches zero. Wang’s cutoff powers instead form a closed hierarchy: H_q=∫eta²a^(q−2)F^q with F=(1+|Rm|²)^(1/2), and Sobolev variable eta a^((q−1)/2)F^(q/2). Its fourth power has the weight of H_(2q), while the curvature reaction is H_(q+1). Keeping the full velocity −2aE, E=Ric+g, reveals that Hessian-a terms are proportional to E; after one integration by parts, |E|≤CF and nabla E=contr(nabla Rm) let the curvature power estimate close using curvature dissipation and |da|²/a=4|dchi|². Under the provisional local Sobolev and neighboring-energy geometry, fixed q=2 and q=3 estimates give the transition-compatible potential A^4 H_3(t)≤C gamma^3/t, gamma=A²||F||_2≤Cr²sqrt(1+K0), without dividing by a or assuming pointwise curvature first.

The corresponding defect norm must be J_m=∫eta²a^(m−2)|E|^m, not the weaker I_m=∫|aE|^m. Initial pointwise pinching directly supplies J_6, and the tensor cancellation propagates this fixed moment. The exact weighted interpolation is Fz_m²=(aF³)^(1/3)(a^(−1/3)z_m²), whose second factor produces J_(3m/2); together with J_(3m/2)≤sqrt(J_mJ_(2m)) and Sobolev, this yields reaction ≤epsilon X_m+C epsilon^(−2)A^4H_3J_m. On positive-time cylinders the natural exponent progression m→3m/2 therefore feeds its own output norms and tends to a|E| pointwise.

The infinite product was made explicit. For q_j=q_0(3/2)^j, sum 1/q_j=3/q_0 and sum (j+log q_j)/q_j is finite, so polynomial exponent losses and nested-cutoff factors converge. Starting at q_0=2 gives the endpoint A²t^(−3/2)(tH_2)^(1/2)=gamma/t; starting at q_0=6 gives A^(2/3)t^(−1/2)(t delta^6 V)^(1/6)=delta(r²/t)^(1/3), with collapsed volume cancelling. Thus the high-exponent product is no longer the obstacle; the remaining work is deriving the exact nested time-space energy recurrence, including time cutoffs, finite-neighbor enlargement, evolving measure, and regularization near a=0.

A second structural simplification removes quantitative connection drift from the zero-order first-exit. Weak H_q, J_m, and unweighted defect estimates integrate Hessian-a away. Bilipschitz metric control alone transfers fixed cutoff-gradient norms, relative Sobolev inequalities on fixed domains, volumes, and buffered containment. The integrable aE bound improves that metric control directly. Hence the previously derived p>4 threshold remains correct for a quantitative weighted derivative estimate, but such an estimate is not needed for this zero-order closure. Smooth continuation can instead generate qualitative derivative bounds internally, following Wang’s triangular induction once that induction is adapted to −2a(Ric+g).

The unweighted defect energy also required correction. An additive epsilon times curvature dissipation can be order epsilon A and need not preserve Q/A→0. The usable structure is triangular: Q_alpha'≤Cr^(−2) sum_(beta near alpha) Q_beta after absorbing a|Rm||E|² with the local critical curvature parameter. Whitney localization remains useful but does not by itself finish the proof: its effective time and radius scale uniformly in the cutoff level, while |a−a0|/a0 is O(c), not O(c²), and a support-wide average does not imply small energy on every Whitney ball. Centered buffered local budgets are required.

This substantially sharpens one four-dimensional negative-branch laboratory but remains far from the full active goal. ## Deep-Reasoning

This step developed the derivative-free first-exit architecture and identified interior plateau regularity as the bridge from zero-order weighted bounds to smooth compactness. ## Deep-Reasoning

This step achieved a structural clarification that sharpens the entire remaining PDE program. The Step 21 TTCS generator proposed a Nash semigroup route that would bypass the weighted Moser hierarchy. The Strategist identified the decisive counterexample: the 4D Hardy potential V = κ/|x|² with 0 < κ < 1 satisfies the small form bound ∫Vφ² ≤ κ∫|∇φ|² but the heat semigroup is NOT ultracontractive—the kernel has a singular spatial weight r^{-σ} with σ = 1-√(1-κ) > 0. This was independently confirmed by TTCS via the Milman–Semenov on-diagonal estimate.

The counterexample reveals a deeper structural principle. In four dimensions, n/2 = 2 is the critical Sobolev exponent. A curvature potential in L² has only a fixed form bound (critical), which the Hardy example shows is insufficient for ultracontractivity. A potential in L³ has form-relative bound zero (subcritical), which allows standard Moser iteration with convergent constants. The Wang hierarchy H₃(t) ≤ Cγ³/(A₀⁴t) provides exactly this critical-to-subcritical upgrade at positive time. This is the essential mechanism: the SINGLE Moser step from H₂ to H₃ is the hard part, and everything after it (higher exponents, L∞ bound, defect propagation) is standard subcritical theory.

The two-stage architecture is now clean: Stage 1 (critical, hard) uses the Wang-type energy inequality to bootstrap H₂ → H₃ through critical Sobolev absorption with the volume-independent β = C√ε_Li. Stage 2 (subcritical, standard) uses standard Moser from L³ to L∞ with convergent constants. The Nash approach can at most compress Stage 2 (which doesn't need compression) and cannot touch Stage 1.

I verified the complete absorption mechanism algebraically: Cauchy–Schwarz factoring H₃ ≤ H₂^{1/2}·||w||₄², outer cutoff Sobolev, graph maximum principle on the finite-neighbor system, self-improvement of γ, and dissipation integral → terminal H₃ bound. All steps close under the small-γ hypothesis. The TTCS verification confirmed all five items with important corrections: the normalized bound is A₀⁴H₃ ≤ Cγ³/t (not just H₃), the conformal-Hardy zero-order term has genuine a⁻² singularity but is screened by natural test functions, and the outer cutoff graph mechanism is algebraically correct but the tensor evolution inequality is not yet proved.

A transcription correction was also established: the correct quadratic form uses ∇(a^{-1/2}φ), not ∇(a⁻¹φ). The leading gradient weight is a⁻¹ (one power) not a⁻² (two powers). This matters near {a=0} and propagates through all subsequent formulas.

The precise critical energy lemma has been formulated: it reduces the entire remaining PDE problem to the tensor evolution of F² under ∂_tg = -2χ²(Ric+g), followed by testing with η² and integration by parts. Everything downstream—subcritical Moser, defect hierarchy, metric comparability, Q preservation, exponential chart, projector contradiction—is either proved or standard.

A02's positive-branch finding adds important dimensional structure: codimension-1 positive Einstein collapse exists in every n ≥ 5 via KK constructions (L(q,1)×N^d), while n=4 is blocked by Bochner. This means the positive branch of Yau 26 in high dimensions cannot rely on collapse obstruction.

The research capital is now concentrated on a single, well-defined PDE problem: the localized evolution inequality for the regularized curvature under the degenerate normalized cutoff flow.

## Deep-Reasoning

The full Yau 26 proposition remains far beyond the present four-dimensional negative laboratory, but this step materially reorganized its central smoothing problem. The preceding handoff treated the remaining work too narrowly as one curvature-tensor calculation. The Strategist correctly separated four independent analytic mechanisms: matched critical absorption, propagation from spacetime control to a terminal slice, homogeneous defect estimates from time zero, and smooth continuation. Re-reading Yang and Wang showed an additional simplification: their critical local-Ricci-flow mechanism is naturally formulated on one controlled support with one flow cutoff, whereas the recent global micro-component graph was an artifact of trying to cover controlled and uncontrolled regions simultaneously.

The existing maximal-function/Vitali construction already produces good macro-supports whose inner balls retain a fixed positive volume proportion after bounded-loss thinning. On each such support, an auxiliary cutoff can equal one near the entire support of the flow cutoff. Then the unweighted factor in Hölder is controlled by the same component energy, while the Sobolev variables retain the flow cutoff: v₂=χF and v₃=χ²F^{3/2}. Their gradients contain precisely the component dissipation plus r^{-2} zero-order terms. This removes both the unsupported outer-to-inner dissipation absorption in Step 22 and the need for a maximal net through the bad region. It also aligns the argument with Yang's one-support Theorem 9.2 and Wang's fixed q=2,3 calculations.

At the integrated tensor level, the decisive structure is preserved by keeping the velocity as -2aE, with E=Ric+g. The curvature variation has the form aΔRm+a(Rm*Rm+Rm)+da*∇E+(∇²a)*E. Since E and ∇E are contractions of Rm+g and ∇Rm, one integration by parts converts every Hessian-a term into the existing tensor-gradient dissipation and the regular factor |da|²/a=4|dχ|². Inverse-metric and measure variations contribute only the weighted curvature reaction. Thus, on a provisional smooth bilipschitz/Sobolev interval, the q=2 and q=3 energies satisfy matched weak inequalities with no evolving cutoff-Hessian bound.

The temporal issue is now explicit. The q=2 estimate gives only an integral of H₃. A good slice in an earlier part of the interval is propagated to the endpoint using the separate fixed-q=3 inequality H₃'≤Cr^{-2}H₃. This rules out narrow terminal spikes and yields the correctly normalized estimate S_j²H₃,j(t)≤Cγ_j³/t, where S_j is the relative Sobolev coefficient and γ_j=S_j||F||₂. The same support geometry also simplifies the homogeneous defect side: global Q obeys Q'≤Cr^{-2}Q after componentwise curvature absorption, and fixed J₆ persists from time zero with its δ⁶ factor, without integrating a 1/t potential from zero.

The symbolic and scaling computations confirm the exact cutoff exponents, collapse-volume cancellation γ=C r²√K₀, cancellation in the defect smoothing prefactor, integrability of metric drift for p>2, and normalization signs on homothetic constant-curvature solutions. They also correct the stationary-model test: when E=0 the total flow and all time derivatives vanish, but H₃ is generally positive and F can vary spatially. What remains is substantial: the universal contraction estimates need a fully written tensor proof with fixed constants; the enlarged support radii and positive-volume thinning must be verified in the actual geometry; positive-time subcritical curvature and defect iterations must be completed; their integrable velocity must close metric and Sobolev comparability; and Yang-Wang continuation must be adapted to the normalized lower-order term. Only then can the bounded-curvature plateaux feed the exponential-chart and calibrated-projector contradiction.

## Deep-Reasoning

This step uncovered and corrected a significant error in the curvature evolution formula for the normalized cutoff flow, then rebuilt the conditional gap theorem chain on a corrected foundation.

The error: Steps 22–23 claimed the conformal piece h = -2ag produces zero lower-order reaction in the Riemann curvature evolution. This is true for the mixed tensor R^l_{ijk} (the Chow–Lu–Ni formula's lower-order R·h terms cancel for conformal h), but false for the physical fully-lowered tensor R_{ijkl}. The index-lowering contribution h_{lm}R^m_{ijk} = φR_{ijkl} is the missing linear term. The decisive test: dg/dt = -2g gives g(t) = e^{-2t}g_0, Christoffel symbols unchanged, R^l_{ijk} unchanged, but R_{ijkl}(t) = e^{-2t}R_{ijkl}(0), confirming ∂_t R_{ijkl} = -2R_{ijkl}.

The correction is structurally beneficial: the linear -2aRm term is a DAMPING that adds +4∫η²aF² to the left of the H₂ inequality. Einstein stationarity holds by the Lichnerowicz identity ΔRm + Q(Rm) = 2Rm for Ric = -g. The quadratic reaction Q(Rm) is unchanged from Wang's unnormalized flow.

The TTCS verification also clarified that the downstream chain from H₃(t) ≤ Cγ³/t to the gap theorem has more dependencies than presented in Step 22. The q = 2,3 energy inequalities alone do not suffice for a full L^∞ bound on the transition (where the operator degenerates). The correct approach uses INTERIOR REGULARITY ON THE PLATEAU (a = 1), where the equation is the standard non-degenerate normalized Ricci flow. There, the energy bounds feed standard parabolic estimates giving |Rm| ≤ C√K₀/θ at time θr² with volume-independent constants. Shi estimates then give uniform derivatives, and Arzelà-Ascoli gives C^∞ compactness leading to an Einstein limit with the calibrated W⁺ spectrum.

The projector contradiction (Step 6) then applies: constant W⁺ spectrum (-1/6, 1/12, 1/12) with δW⁺ = 0 forces ∇W⁺ = 0 by the projector lemma, but the locally symmetric Einstein 4-manifolds with Ric = -g (H⁴ and CH²) have |W⁺|² ∈ {0, 1/6}, not 1/24. This excludes the calibrated germ.

The remaining five PDE obligations T1–T5 are precisely identified: exact tensor inequality for F² including the -4aF² damping (T1), separate q = 3 inequality (T2), homogeneous defect inequalities (T3), interior Shi for normalized flow (T4), and Yang-Wang continuation (T5). A01's Codex worker is addressing T1 independently.

A02's toric BREAK verdict (Step 25) is important dimensional context: integral identities alone cannot obstruct the α-family on #_k(S²×S²), so the positive branch needs a global PDE solvability obstruction. This is consistent with the high-dimensional KK compatibility from A02 Step 24. The positive branch remains structurally different from the negative branch.

The research capital is now: a corrected and sharper conditional gap theorem for critical 4D negative Ishida-LeBrun manifolds, with the precise PDE–topology interface clearly separated, and the damping from normalization recognized as beneficial rather than absent.

## Deep-Reasoning

The complete Yau 26 problem remains unresolved, but this step repaired the analytic core of the most developed four-dimensional negative-branch route. The first repair concerns normalization. Although the fully covariant curvature tensor contains the correct term \(-2a\operatorname{Rm}\), it cannot be interpreted alone as curvature-energy damping. Under \(\partial_tg=-2ag\), the tensor contraction contributes \(-4a|\operatorname{Rm}|^2\), four inverse metrics contribute \(+8a|\operatorname{Rm}|^2\), and in dimension four the measure contributes \(-4a|\operatorname{Rm}|^2\). Thus \(|\operatorname{Rm}|^2d\mu\) is scale invariant. More generally, for \(F=(1+|\operatorname{Rm}|^2)^{1/2}\), the pure-normalization contribution is \(2a[(p-2)F^p-pF^{p-2}]d\mu\). The route must therefore rely on matched Sobolev absorption and homogeneous defect propagation, not artificial coercivity from normalization.

The second repair restores transition-region control. Plateau regularity is sufficient for positive-time higher derivatives and the eventual smooth local limit, but it cannot preserve the metric, relative Sobolev inequality, cutoff-gradient norm, or support geometry in the collar where \(0<a<1\). The correct bridge is a whole-support weighted iteration. On one buffered good support, the verified fixed-exponent estimates give persistence of \(H_2\), terminal control \(\mathsf S^2H_3(t)\lesssim \bar\beta_*^3/t\), and preservation of \(J_6\). Here it is safest to use \(\bar\beta=\mathsf S H_2^{1/2}\), or explicitly subtract the stationary auxiliary collar, rather than identify the active-support norm with the larger auxiliary energy without proof.

A central structural observation is that the weighted hierarchy exactly matches Yang's fixed-cutoff Moser iteration in dimension four. Yang's exponents satisfy \(p_{j+1}=3p_j/2\), \(p'_{j+1}=3p'_j/2+1\), and if \(p'_0=p_0-2\), then \(p'_j=p_j-2\). Hence Yang's moments \(\chi^{2p'_j}\Phi^{p_j}\) are precisely \(a^{p_j-2}\Phi^{p_j}\), and their endpoint is \(a\Phi\). Choosing potential exponent six makes Yang's weighted potential exactly \(H_3=\int aF^3\). The interpolation identity \(a^{p-1}F\Phi^p=(aF^3)^{1/3}(a^{3p/2-2}\Phi^{3p/2})^{2/3}\), followed by Sobolev and Young inequalities, produces a polynomial-in-\(p\) coefficient \(Cp^3(r^{-2}+\mathsf S^2H_3)\), so the later iteration no longer requires a shrinking critical-smallness threshold. Starting at \(p_0=3\) yields the whole-support scale \(\|a\operatorname{Rm}(t)\|_\infty\lesssim\bar\beta_*/t\); starting at \(p_0=6\) and using propagated \(J_6\) yields \(\|aE(t)\|_\infty\lesssim\delta(r^2/t)^{1/3}\). The latter is integrable at zero and gives the missing collar metric comparison.

Independent verification supported the normalization formula, interpolation exponents, exact Yang-weight correspondence, and endpoint scales. It also located the remaining mathematical work: the general-\(p\) tensor inequality has not yet received the same complete index-level treatment as the verified \(q=2,3\) and quadratic defect estimates; noninteger cutoff powers and \(|E|\)-regularization must be handled; and the normalized Yang-Wang high-derivative extension argument must be written. A source search further indicates that a normalized local Sobolev inequality on collapsed balls may follow from a Ricci lower bound alone: the cited Maheux--Saloff-Coste theorem gives, in dimension four, \(\|u\|_4^2\lesssim r^2\operatorname{Vol}(B_r)^{-1/2}\|\nabla u\|_2^2\) for compactly supported functions, with constants depending on the lower Ricci scale. This would remove a major geometric initialization concern, but the original paper was not acquired; only its metadata and a detailed secondary quotation were obtained, so the exact theorem must still be checked at source level.

Once whole-support zero-order control and normalized continuation are established, higher derivatives are needed only on a smaller \(a=1\) plateau. The terminal geometric obstruction remains exactly the Step 6 projector argument: the calibrated Einstein spectrum forces \(\nabla W^+=0\), while the Einstein--Weyl scalar identity forces \(|\nabla W^+|^2=1/16\). Parallel \(W^+\) does not imply parallel full curvature, so no locally symmetric classification enters. Even completion of this chain would establish only a pinching gap for a critical four-dimensional negative Ishida--LeBrun family; the positive branch, unrestricted topology, dimensions at least five, dimension-only interval constants, and Lean formalization remain open.

## Deep-Reasoning

This step resolved two of the three remaining analytic obstacles for the four-dimensional negative-branch conditional gap theorem. The research position is now sharply defined: the entire conditional chain from Ricci pinching to the projector contradiction depends on a single unproved theorem—the smooth continuation of the normalized degenerate cutoff flow.

The first resolved obstacle was the general-p weighted tensor inequality. A01's Codex worker had previously established the index-level derivation for the fixed exponents q=2 (critical curvature energy), q=3 (weighted subcritical curvature potential), and the quadratic defect Q. This step extended that derivation to all p ≥ 3 for both curvature and defect. The key structure is: the boundary term d(η²a^{p-1}) has a d(η) part that vanishes identically because a^{p-1} = 0 on supp(dη) for p ≥ 3, and a da part that gives Cp² r^{-2} K_p via the identity a^{p-3}|da|² = 4a^{p-2}|dχ|². The Hessian-a integration by parts produces the same type of remainder. The algebraic reaction is bounded by Cp∫η²a^{p-1}FΦ^p, and the full Young/Sobolev chain gives polynomial p³ growth—sufficient for the Moser iteration convergence since Σ(j+log p_j)/p_j < ∞. For the defect, the regularization Φ_ε = (|E|²+ε²)^{1/2} has the correct chain rule (∂_t-aΔ)Φ_ε^p = (p/2)Φ_ε^{p-2}(∂_t-aΔ)|E|² - p(p-2)aΦ_ε^{p-2}|∇Φ_ε|², with all estimates ε-uniform. The limit ε→0 uses dominated convergence for zero-order terms and weak lower semicontinuity for gradient dissipation. Noninteger powers a^{p-2} for the Moser sequence p_j = 3·(3/2)^j require either infinitely flat cutoff or W^{1,∞} approximation, not the naive claim that χ^α is smooth for all α.

The second resolved obstacle was the initial relative Sobolev inequality on collapsed selected balls. The Maheux–Saloff-Coste theorem (Math. Ann. 303, 1995, Theorem 1.1) provides S = C(n,Kr²)·r²·Vol(B_r)^{-1/2} on any geodesic ball with only Ric ≥ kg, with C independent of volume. The proof combines Bishop-Gromov doubling and Buser's Poincaré inequality. For compactly supported functions, the mean subtraction passage adds only a lower-order r^{-2}||u||₂² term. In dimension four with K = 1+δ and the Li radius r = r*, Kr² is uniformly bounded, so C is uniform. The volume dependence enters only through the explicit Vol^{-1/2} factor, which is exactly the scaling used throughout the weighted energy argument.

The single remaining analytic obligation is the normalized Yang-Wang smooth continuation/extension theorem: showing that bounded |χ²Rm| suffices to extend the flow ∂_tg = -2χ²(Ric+g). A detailed specification was written, identifying exactly which lemmas in Wang's proof require adaptation and showing that all new terms from -2χ²g are controlled by the same induction structure.
